title: Classroom pendulum (real footage)
description: A real classroom string pendulum. The yellow arrow on the board marks the pendulum length as 0.5 m, from the pivot (the white dot at the top).
credit: Excerpt of “Pendelgesetz (mit Rechnung)” by Mathe-AC Lernwerkstatt Aachen (Rhetos), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Trimmed and re-encoded.

title: Synthetic pendulum
description: Rendered 0.5 m pendulum at a 10° swing, so the true g is known (9.81). The pivot is the black square; the bar at the bottom is 0.5 m.

title: Synthetic collision
description: Two equal balls in a perfectly elastic collision, so momentum and kinetic energy are both conserved.
